svg.title: One track change, end to end
svg.desc: Animation: after a track change the dashboard shows the new track after about 1 second while the PaperColor decodes, sends and refreshes, showing the new cover after about 19.6 seconds. Chart: v1.8 took 22.8 seconds (notice 2.5, download 1.7, decode 0.6, dither and send 3.2, refresh 14.8); v1.9 takes 19.6 seconds (notice 1.0, download 0, decode 0.6, dither and send 3.2, refresh 14.8).
svg.text: One track change, end to end
The dashboard shows the new track within a poll. The e-paper follows once the cover is drawn, sent and refreshed.
seconds after the track changes in Volumio
Time from track change to the new cover on the e-paper
Measured on the device (lastRender in /api/status). “Notice change” is the average wait: half the polling interval.
The 14.8 s refresh is the Spectra 6 panel's own cycle; Liner can't shorten it, but the dashboard no longer waits for it.
